semanticRule: Three numeric evaluations may coexist only because they answer different questions. Mizan Score measures product quality; AZIZ utility selects among integrated candidates; Home Design evaluation is advisory. Only AZIZ owns canonical candidate selection in the current integrated flow.
futureRule: Before Mizan Score V1 implementation, define an explicit adapter if AZIZ is to consume Mizan Score. Do not silently equate existing AZIZ utility axes with Mizan Score V1.
